title: Owner runs bring-up steps 5–6 on the Pi (pump calibration, levels, a first feed, safety)
goal: Each pump delivers its calibrated volume ± 10 % and stopping the agent or hub stops a running pump
acceptance: Steps 5, 5b and 6 of the hardware bring-up pass, or each failure is reported
Owner go-ahead for every run on the real rig (AGENTS.md, Hardware); the agent never switches hardware itself.
privacy: Neutral, invented test data only; no Tailscale names, IPs, agent tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-24: about 2 h at the rig with a measuring jug.
